assessment: Richtsmeier and colleagues demonstrate that chondrocranium and dermatocranium development are associated and that mutations in Fgfr significantly alter skull shape in part via the chondrocranium by means of a 3D modeling technique. The study is inspiring in providing new data regarding the role of the chondrocranium in normal craniofacial development and shedding light on the putative correspondence between chondrocranial elements and dermal skull bones. This work will be of interest to readers in the fields of vertebrate developmental biology, evolutionary anatomy, genetic disease, and vertebrate paleontology.
